Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **Program Overview**


The program is an IDIQ contract for an AWS\-based cloud hosting system. Currently, Peraton is supporting the Cloud Security, IoT, and AIML use cases for the environment in a hybrid work environment with Federal employees. Peraton also support the following applications as part of the environment: Dremio, Tableau, Globus, Posit/RStudio, Atlassian, ThingLogix, Alteryx and CloudCheckr.
##### **About The Role**


Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web\-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA\-listed species.

  

Peraton is seeking a **Lead Business Analyst** to serve as the senior BA lead on a federal environmental data integration program. * Conduct gap analysis between current platform capabilities and integration requirements, documenting findings for technical deliverables
* Facilitate joint requirements workshops with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) Ecological Services and NOAA Fisheries SMEs

* Support compliance validation by verifying that species list generation, decision logic, template content, and consultation routing meet regulatory requirements
* Coordinate with government SMEs to obtain required approvals and sign\-offs on compliance\-critical deliverables
* Lead pilot consultation workflow design, defining scenarios covering all consultation types
* Analyze pilot results and live consultation feedback, translating findings into actionable system updates
* Lead the development of the Pilot Report with Metrics, capturing consultation cycle times, completion rates, defect summaries, and actionable findings from pilot workflow execution
* Lead the development of the Endangered Species Act \- Section 7 Compliance Validation Checklist, documenting validation criteria for species list generation accuracy, decision logic correctness, template content completeness, and consultation routing
* Coordinate government review and acceptance of Updated DKeys and Consultation Package Builder Assets, ensuring all content meets regulatory requirements and agency sign\-off is obtained
* Contribute to final operational documentation and year\-end reporting

* Bachelors degree and 10 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 8 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 12 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 16 years’ professional experience.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
* Extensive years of business analysis experience on federal IT programs
* Expertise in Endangered Species Act \- Section 7 consultation processes
* Experience with federal environmental regulatory systems and multi\-agency coordination
* Strong requirements elicitation, documentation, and stakeholder facilitation skills
* Experience supporting compliance validation activities on federal programs
* Experience capturing and reporting pilot metrics including cycle times, completion rates, and defect summaries
* Experience facilitating OMB or executive\-level government reviews and demonstration preparation

* Experience with DOI, FWS, or NOAA Fisheries programs
* Familiarity with data migration or system integration projects in a federal context
* Active Public Trust Clearance

Iron EagleX (IEX), a wholly owned subsidiary of General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT), delivers agile IT and Intelligence solutions. Combining small\-team flexibility with global scale, IEX leverages emerging technologies to provide innovative, user\-focused solutions that empower organizations and end users to operate smarter, faster, and more securely in dynamic environments.

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**


Iron EagleX is seeking a Senior Principal Intelligence Analyst to support our analytics teams in Crystal City, VA. In this role, you will conduct advanced all\-source analysis while working closely with multi\-discipline analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and developers to improve the speed, depth, and quality of analytic production. You will apply expert analytic tradecraft to interpret complex information from multiple sources, identify patterns and gaps, develop defensible assessments, and help shape data\-driven approaches to mission problems. You will help translate analytic questions into data requirements, evaluate the usefulness of data outputs, provide subject matter context for models and tools, and ensure that technical capabilities remain aligned to impactful analytics.

As a Senior Principal Intelligence Analyst, you will help transform complex, multi\-source information into clear, timely, and actionable assessments that support decision\-making. Your work will directly influence how data, analytics, and AI\-enabled tools are applied to real\-world intelligence problems. By working closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, and analysts, you will help ensure that emerging technical capabilities are grounded in analytic tradecraft, operational relevance, and mission needs.

  

**JOB DUTIES** (INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO)


* Conduct expert\-level all\-source analysis using structured analytic techniques, intelligence tradecraft, and multiple information sources to produce defensible assessments, insights, and recommendations.
* Analyze complex datasets, reporting streams, operational information, and mission\-relevant source material to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, relationships, risks, and intelligence gaps.
* Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, developers, and analysts to translate mission questions into data requirements, analytic workflows, technical use cases, and measurable outcomes.
* Provide subject matter expertise to support the design, evaluation, and refinement of data models, analytic tools, AI\-enabled workflows, and decision\-support capabilities.
* Review and assess outputs from data science models, AI tools, search systems, automated extraction processes, and analytic platforms for relevance, accuracy, explainability, and mission value.
* Support the development of analytic methodologies that combine traditional all\-source tradecraft with data\-driven techniques, automated discovery, knowledge management, and AI\-assisted analysis.
* Identify data gaps, quality issues, source limitations, collection shortfalls, and analytic constraints that affect the reliability of assessments or technical outputs.
* Produce written assessments, briefings, analytic notes, and decision\-support products tailored to mission, operational, and technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate with full stack developers and data engineers to ensure analytic workflows, tool interfaces, and data access patterns support realistic analyst needs without assuming responsibility for software development or front\-end implementation.
* Apply rigorous sourcing, confidence levels, assumptions, alternative analysis, and evidence evaluation to ensure analytic products are transparent, credible, and defensible.
* Support the integration of AI\-enabled tools into analytic workflows by testing outputs, identifying failure modes, refining prompts or analytic use cases, and documenting appropriate use cases and limitations.

* Expert\-level experience conducting all\-source analysis in support of intelligence, defense, national security, law enforcement, or mission\-focused operational environments.
* Strong understanding of all\-source analytic tradecraft, including source evaluation, structured analytic techniques, confidence statements, assumption testing, alternative analysis, and intelligence writing standards.
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information from multiple sources into clear, concise, and defensible analytic judgments.
* Experience working with large, complex, or multi\-source datasets in support of analytic production, operational assessments, targeting, threat analysis, network analysis, or mission planning.
* Ability to translate mission questions and analytic problems into data requirements, technical use cases, workflow needs, and evaluation criteria for technical teams.

DARPAs All\-Source intelligence/counterintelligence (CI) program includes detecting, identifying, assessing, and, in conjunction with the assigned CI support activity, analyzing information on adversary intentions and capabilities. This may include developing programs, systems, and procedures designed to counter foreign intelligence collection efforts and activities of foreign entities, including sabotage and terrorist activities.


All\-Source/CI analysts recommend cost\-effective protective measures and countermeasures for DARPA personnel, programs, and activities. All\-Source/CI Analyst will enable DARPAs organic intelligence/CI program to realize the positive attributes inherent in combining IC resources with a trained/qualified internal multi\-disciplined security team in applying All\-Source Intelligence/CI context to protecting DARPA programs. This nascent internal structure will develop or adapt existing programs, systems, and procedures to proactively counter foreign intelligence collection efforts and activities, including sabotage and terrorist activities.


The All\-Source/CI Analyst will perform the following responsibilities:

jobs.title: Counterintelligence & Security Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Counterintelligence (CI) and Security Investigations Team's safeguards Anduril's workforce and supply chain by proactively identifying risk, mitigating threats and delivering actionable investigative insights*.*The team helps ensure our security environment remains vigilant and resilient so that our strategic interests are preserved. We are committed to anticipating and mitigating risks and threats enabling Anduril to innovate and operate confidently in a dynamic global environment.

  

### **ABOUT THE POSITION**



Anduril is seeking a professional to support the CI and Security Investigations team in a unique opportunity to help strategize, socialize and implement a CI and security risk program that requires significant critical thinking, creativity, complex problem solving and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to work across a rapidly growing, global, dynamic organization to identify and mitigate threats. The Counterintelligence \& Security Risk Analyst Lead is responsible for analyzing threats from nation state actors and insiders affecting Anduril's workforce, technologies and supply chain globally. The role will involve the development and support of analytic efforts and work\-streams that integrate across key business processes and stakeholders, spanning people vetting, supplier and vendor risk, and enterprise CI analysis, to enable rapid mitigation and informed decision making. This position will leverage a variety of internal and external data sets and tools to develop a robust understanding of the threat environment. The Analyst must be a self\-starter that can operate independently and be responsive to fast paced and dynamic operational and threat environments, and must possess a deep understanding of CI, intelligence analysis, risk management, and a demonstrated ability to analyze and communicate complex risks and threats.

  

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Support the development of CI analysis tailored to the defense industry's unique threats and requirements, spanning workforce, technology and supply chain risk.
* Analyze threats from nation state actors, reviewing data from multiple sources to identify anomalous behaviors and other indicators.
* Execute workforce, visitor and supplier vetting initiatives, conducting thorough risk assessments and initial investigations to ensure Anduril is engaging with trusted people and vendors.
* Support a repeatable, scalable process for vetting of candidates, visitors, suppliers and vendors, and continuously monitor existing relationships for emerging risks.
* Coordinate with federal agencies, including the Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), and Federal Law Enforcement, to access relevant threat information and stay current on evolving adversary tactics, techniques and procedures.
* Establish and leverage collaborative partnerships across internal stakeholders, including product, supply chain, legal, HR, and InfoSec teams, to identify data necessary to support robust research and analysis.
* Produce tailored and strategic risk assessments, detailed reports and presentations on findings, case studies, threat assessments, and recommended actions for multiple audiences to include senior leadership.
* Develop and implement analytic methodologies to assess counterintelligence, supplier and people related risks.
* Provide analytic support to investigations.
* Support the development of procedures, processes, risk frameworks and documentation that comply with government regulations and contractual obligations, and produce key metrics for leadership on a recurring basis.
* Monitor, analyze and communicate trends in people or supplier risk and nation state\-related risk and threats to help shape vetting and mitigation initiatives.
* Support the development of training and awareness materials and present tailored briefings to internal audiences.
* Travel as needed to support risk assessments at various Anduril site locations or external events.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Security or Intelligence Studies, Political Science, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
* 8 years of relevant work experience in CI analysis, intelligence operations or analysis, or people and supplier risk vetting, assessing complex threats from nation state actors and other nation state\-related risk.
* Experience conducting risk and threat assessments and presenting analysis to inform executive decision making.
* Demonstrated ability leveraging multiple data sets and tools to support complex research and analysis, as well as developing risk assessments and risk mitigation recommendations.
* Experience conducting public record research and investigations (e.g., criminal, civil, financial, corporate, property, licensing, or court records) in support of people and supplier vetting, or CI\-related assessments.
* Ability to synthesize public record findings with open\-source and other data sets to assess credibility, relevance, and risk, and communicate findings to technical and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with CI risk assessment methodologies and CI threat analysis.
* Experience leveraging critical thinking skills to creatively solve complex problem

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a leader in Lawful and Location Intelligence, SS8 helps make societies safer. Our commitment is to extract, analyze, and visualize the critical intelligence that gives law enforcement, intelligence agencies, and emergency services the real\-time insights that help save lives. Our high performance, flexible, and future\-proof solutions also enable mobile network operators to achieve regulatory compliance with minimum disruption, time, and cost. SS8 is trusted by the largest government agencies, communications providers, and systems integrators globally.

**Overview**



We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our team and to support the full lifecycle of U.S. Government opportunities and programs—from early customer engagement and proposal development through contracting, project execution, customer adoption, and long\-term relationship management.  

This role will serve as a critical bridge between SS8's Government Sales organization, customers, partners, Engineering, Product Management, Contracts, and other internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines strong program management and communication skills with experience supporting government customers, bids and proposals, contracts, and technology\-driven programs.  

Depending on project demands, the role may spend significant periods supporting the sales process but will transition to project / program delivery as their core function and priority when required.  

This individual does not need to be a telecommunications engineer but must be technically savvy, comfortable learning complex software and technology environments, and capable of translating between technical teams, business stakeholders, and government customers.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project \& Program Execution**


* Lead cross\-functional teams responsible for the successful deployment, integration, testing, acceptance, and operationalization of SS8 software and services.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans with clearly defined milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Manage project risks, issues, schedules, resources, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Manage the requirements lifecycle and ensure alignment between customer expectations, contractual commitments, and technical implementation.
* Coordinate acceptance testing and ensure completion of contractual deliverables and customer acceptance criteria.
* Manage project scope and support the development and execution of change requests when requirements evolve.
* Provide regular program status updates to customers and SS8 leadership.
* Follow established program governance, schedules, responsibilities, communication plans, and internal/customer reporting processes.
* Track contract deliverables, modifications, funding actions, option periods, and other milestones that may impact program execution.
* Conduct lessons\-learned sessions and track resulting actions in order to incorporate findings into future programs and proposals.


**Customer Success \& Relationship Management**


* Serve as a primary point of coordination for customers throughout program execution.
* Maintain regular communication with government stakeholders to ensure visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and upcoming milestones.
* Work proactively to identify and resolve customer concerns before they impact program success.
* Help customers understand SS8 capabilities and identify opportunities to increase utilization or apply SS8 technology to additional mission requirements.
* Partner with Sales leadership to support account planning, follow\-on opportunities, contract renewals, and program expansion.
* Maintain awareness of customer priorities, funding cycles, procurement activities, and organizational changes that may affect the program or broader account.


**Contract \& Program Transition**


* Support the transition of awarded opportunities from Sales and Capture into formal project / program execution.
* Review contract requirements, Statements of Work, deliverables, milestones, reporting obligations, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with Contracts, Finance, Engineering, Product, Sales, and partners to ensure contractual and operational requirements are understood.


**Government Opportunity \& Customer Support**


* Support Government Sales leadership throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from initial customer engagement through contract award and execution.
* Assist in preparing customer communications, capability briefs, white papers, presentations, meeting materials, and follow\-up actions.
* Participate in customer discovery sessions to understand mission requirements, operational challenges, technical environments, procurement considerations, and desired outcomes.
* Maintain continuity between pre\-award customer conversations and post\-award execution to ensure commitments and requirements are understood and delivered.
* Develop trusted relationships with government customers, industry partners, integrators, and other program stakeholders.
* Identify follow\-on requirements, expansion opportunities, and emerging customer needs during program execution.


**Capture, Bid \& Proposal Support**


* Coordinate and support responses to RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, solution briefs, Sources Sought notices, and other government acquisition activities.
* Manage proposal schedules, compliance matrices, action items, contributors, reviews, and submission requirements.
* Work with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, Contracts, and partners to translate customer requirements into executable technical and programmatic solutions.
* Support development and review of Statements of Work, technical approaches, implementation plans, schedules, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain reusable proposal content, past performance information, program documentation, and other government business collateral.
* Help ensure commitments made during the sales and proposal process

**ABOUT US:**


CircusTrix is the leading indoor active entertainment company in the U.S., operating and franchising over 270 parks with more than 500,000 members and 60\+ attractions. We create fun, high\-energy experiences for all ages while hosting thousands of memorable birthdays, team events, and school parties each year. Recognized by Franchise Times and Entrepreneur, our success is driven by a culture of curiosity, creativity, and growth. At Sky Zone, we empower builders, problem\-solvers, and lifelong learners to explore bold ideas, challenge assumptions, and make a meaningful impact—creating a place where imagination thrives and people are inspired to grow.

**JOB SUMMARY:**


We’re looking for a Senior Data Business Analyst who can turn ambiguous business questions into clear, trusted reporting. You’ll own our Power BI reporting environment end to end — from semantic model design to stakeholder delivery — and partner directly with senior and executive leaders to build the analytics that drive decisions across the business. This is a hands\-on role for someone who loves solving messy data problems and communicating what the numbers actually mean.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports and semantic models, including DAX measures, calculated columns, and interactive data visualizations
* Write and maintain Snowflake SQL for reporting pipelines, data quality checks, and ad hoc analysis requests
* Develop performance analytics around KPIs and other metrics to support key business initiatives
* Partner directly with business stakeholders — including senior and executive\-level requestors — to gather requirements and translate ambiguous business questions into clear technical specifications and solutions
* Own the day\-to\-day intake, triage, and execution of Power BI reporting service desk requests, including prioritization and stakeholder communication on status and timelines
* Troubleshoot data quality issues and discrepancies across reporting platforms, working cross\-functionally to resolve root causes
* Maintain and improve documentation for reporting logic, data definitions, and BI assets
* Coordinate with internal IT and data teams to maintain and improve reporting integrity

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* High School Diploma required. Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., business, finance, economics, computer science, statistics) or equivalent practical experience, preferred.
* Exceptional hands\-on experience with Power BI, including advanced DAX (measures, calculated columns, semantic model design)
* Experience building financial performance analytics and deriving insights that drive value creation for the business
* Willingness to take on problems without knowing the answer up front — grit and determination to work through ambiguity and find a solution
* Ability to manage stakeholder expectations and competing timelines effectively
* Experience with Snowflake specifically (strongly preferred; candidates with strong SQL but no Snowflake experience will still be considered)
* Exposure to AI platforms or tools (e.g., AI\-assisted analytics, LLM\-based tools)
* Familiarity with retail, entertainment, franchise, or multi\-location operations businesses
* Advanced SQL skills (CTEs, joins, aggregations, troubleshooting) and familiarity with star schemas, fact/dimension tables, and semantic model design
* Strong business acumen and the ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders, gather requirements, and translate them into technical solutions
* Strong Excel skills (data connections, data manipulation, pivot tables, formulas)
* Solid written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to senior and executive stakeholders
* Advanced SQL skills (CTEs, joins, aggregations, troubleshooting) and familiarity with star schemas, fact/dimension tables, and semantic model design
* Strong business acumen and the ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders, gather requirements, and translate them into technical solutions
* Strong Excel skills (data connections, data manipulation, pivot tables, formulas)
* Solid written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to senior and executive stakeholders

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* This position requires the ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working on a computer and communicating via phone and Teams with or without reasonable accommodation.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

***Compensation range******is $100,000\-110,000*** *\+ bonus opportunity, based on qualifications, experience, and performance. Full\-time employees at CircusTrix enjoy a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage along with a 401k plan with company matching. Eligibility for 401k is based on age and tenure requirements.*

jobs.description:

Business Systems Analysis **Travel Required****:**


Up to 10% **Clearance Required****:**


Ability to Obtain Public Trust**Job Description Summary**


The Business/Systems Analyst will support requirements analysis, process definition, stakeholder engagement, and solution alignment for a large\-scale agile software development and platform modernization program supporting the GrantSolutions contract. This role is responsible for eliciting, documenting, analyzing, and validating business needs, system requirements, workflows, data exchanges, integration dependencies, and operational impacts across multiple workstreams and Scrum teams. The Business/Systems Analyst will work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Technical Leads, enterprise architects, vendors, Federal stakeholders, and end users to translate modernization objectives into clear, actionable requirements and support high\-quality outcomes across the system development lifecycle.

**What You Will Do****:**


We are seeking a strong Business/Systems Analyst to support requirements, process, and solution analysis for a large\-scale GrantSolutions platform modernization effort. This role will work across business stakeholders, Federal users, vendors, architects, and agile delivery teams to define current\-state and future\-state workflows, clarify business needs, document functional and non\-functional requirements, and support incremental capability delivery while maintaining continuity of the legacy system throughout the transition.


The Business/Systems Analyst will help bridge business operations, user needs, system functionality, data exchanges, and technical delivery in an iterative modernization environment. This individual will analyze and document requirements for a modern integration layer that enables new vendor\-delivered capabilities to interface with legacy components as the modernized platform is built out over time. The role requires strong analytical judgment and collaboration with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Technical Leads, enterprise architects, vendors, executive leadership, and Federal stakeholders to support alignment with platform architecture, governance standards, release readiness, and program objectives.

* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, non\-functional, data, reporting, workflow, and integration requirements for a large\-scale platform modernization program delivered through iterative agile execution.
* Develop current\-state and future\-state process flows, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, interface requirements, and operational impact analyses to support incremental modernization.
* Support modernization workstreams across the application development lifecycle, including integration\-layer delivery, legacy coexistence, testing, deployment, training, and rollout activities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Technical Leads, enterprise architects, vendors, and Federal stakeholders to refine backlogs, clarify scope, manage requirements traceability, and support prioritization of incremental capabilities.
* Analyze integration\-related needs, including APIs, data exchange patterns, interface dependencies, shared services, system handoffs, and interactions between legacy components and modernized capabilities.
* Identify and document legacy coexistence considerations, including workflow continuity, system\-of\-record decisions, duplicate processing paths, data synchronization, testing scenarios, operational readiness, and transition impacts.
* Support requirements reviews, design discussions, sprint planning, backlog grooming, demonstrations, user acceptance testing, defect triage, change impact assessments, and release readiness activities.
* Maintain analysis artifacts, including requirements documentation, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, traceability matrices, decision logs, interface coordination materials, and stakeholder communications.
* Translate technical integration concepts, modernization constraints, and delivery dependencies into clear business language for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Foster strong working relationships across Federal stakeholders, vendors, delivery teams, architects, and partners to support coordinated modernization outcomes and long\-term platform success.

 **What You Will Need****:**

* Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required.

The Operations Program Manager will be the central coordinator for scheduled operational activities affecting customers, production services and managed CPE fleets. * Support the development of training and awareness materials and present tailored briefings to internal audiences.
* Travel as needed to support risk assessments at various Anduril site locations or external events.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Partners internally and externally to make effective business decisions; determines and carries out processes and methodologies; solves complex problems; escalates high\-priority issues or risks, as appropriate; monitors progress and results. Develops work plans to meet business priorities and deadlines; coordinates and delegates resources to accomplish organizational goals. Recognizes and capitalizes on improvement opportunities; evaluates recommendations made; influences the completion of project tasks by others.
* Manages large\-scale programs or components with multiple workstreams and strategic business goals across departments, functions, or regions with responsibility and accountability for achieving program outcomes from initiation to close\-out in an extended or open ended time frame. Develops, analyzes, and manages highly complex program plans which include scope identification and management, schedule, inter\-dependencies, and resource forecast. Manages and monitors the program financials of large\-scale programs. Monitors program performance to ensure programs effectively deliver maximum long term value or benefit to the organization, and makes adjustments as needed in an uncertain environment where scope may be fluid. Leads program activities related to organizational change management (e.g., development and execution of user adoption, implementation, and training plans) as defined by the program. Drives allocation of resources, establishes schedules, and task assignments to ensure established program management practices are in place. This role may perform project management duties in addition to program management responsibilities.
* Leads the work of large program teams by monitoring internal and external resources. Leads others in requesting and coordinating internal and/ or external resources based on the alignment of team member skills and program demands. Communicates a clear vision of program goals and objectives to the team. Delivers performance feedback to team members supervisors.
* Proactively monitors, identifies, and mitigates program risks, issues, and trigger events by developing mitigation plans and strategies; and resolving or escalating risks or issues as appropriate.
* Monitors adherence of program activities to policies and procedures by ensuring program plans and team members follow KP, departmental, and/or business line policies and procedures.
* Ensures the alignment, buy\-in, engagement and support of diverse program stakeholders by building and maintaining relationships as well as communicating appropriately with internal customers, third party vendors, senior management, and business leaders; and clarifying accountability and authority across stakeholders. Identifies and works closely with key stakeholders based on their level of influence and decision making and ensures all appropriate stakeholders are represented and included. Provides insight to key stakeholders and program sponsors by developing program goals, setting the prioritization of deliverables, discussing involvement of business processes (e.g. program change management, communication) and facilitating decisions necessary for program delivery. Communicates tough issues to stakeholders while maintaining an independent opinion, providing recommendations, delivering formal presentations, and providing reports to various senior audiences.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Integration Partnerships
jobs.description:
**About Rivet**  

Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  

  

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  

  

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission\-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  

  

**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).**

**Summary**


The Deployment Strategist (DS) ensures the successful definition, implementation, and operations of new systems with Rivet customers. The DS guides customer and Rivet collaboration, aligning teams and deployment plans to meet mutual objectives.


The strategist is responsible for analyzing customer conditions, understanding data insights, and developing actionable plans to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, the DS anticipates potential challenges, devising solutions to mitigate risks – or to achieve win/win competitive advantage.


As a relationship manager, the DS serves as a liaison between technical teams and customer stakeholders, facilitating clear understanding of project goals and progress. The strategist monitors deployment activities, provides regular updates, and ensures fidelity to agreed timelines and milestones. This role favors strong planning skills, acumen for technology breakthroughs with large customers, and a bias toward iterative action. At Rivet, the DS is uniquely positioned to create long\-term value with customers trusting us with their most strategic projects.


In addition to deployment execution, the DS plays a key role in shaping new business opportunities. This includes partnering with commercial and technical teams to scope prospective engagements, contribute to technical and programmatic proposals, and translate customer needs into compelling, executable plans. The DS ensures continuity between what is proposed and what is ultimately delivered.

**For this particular role, the DS, Integration Partnerships will build and manage a network of technology and industry partners that extends Rivet’s capabilities and accelerates customer outcomes. You will source and triage potential partners, evaluate their technology and strategic fit, develop relationships and integration opportunities, and manage partnerships from initial engagement through deployment and ongoing growth. This role requires strong technical judgment, commercial acumen, and the ability to identify where combining Rivet with complementary technologies can create differentiated solutions and unlock new customer opportunities.**

**Responsibilities**

* Source and develop relationships with technology and industry partners whose capabilities can complement Rivet’s products and create differentiated solutions for customers
* Triage and evaluate prospective partners based on technical capabilities, strategic fit, customer demand, integration complexity, and potential business value
* Work closely with Rivet engineering, product, and commercial teams to define integration opportunities, technical approaches, joint solutions, and paths to deployment
* Develop and manage partner relationships from initial engagement through integration, deployment, and ongoing expansion, serving as the primary point of coordination across organizations
* Identify opportunities to leverage partnerships to accelerate customer deployments, expand Rivet’s capabilities, and create new business opportunities
* Act as the internal and external owner for strategic partnerships, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and mutual objectives

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in technology partnerships, business development, technical sales, product strategy, deployment, or a similar customer\- or partner\-facing role
* Demonstrated ability to source, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships involving complex technology products or integrated solutions
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand, evaluate, and communicate the capabilities and limitations of hardware and software technologies
* Experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, product, commercial, and customer teams to bring integrated solutions from concept to deployment
* Exceptional relationship\-building and communication skills, with the ability to establish trust and drive outcomes across senior technical, commercial, and operational stakeholders
* Ability to travel 35\-70%; we are building sophisticated, controlled systems with hardware and software – you will be embedded with the team in office or at the customer point of need
* This position requires U.S. citizenship due to contract obligations; must hold an active U.S. security clearance and/or have the ability to be cleared


Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job\-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits

jobs.title: Business Analyst 1 - Export & Parts Pricing Support
jobs.description:
**CLIENT HIGHLIGHT**The client you will be working for is a Top 20 Fortune Global 500 Consumer Electronics and Technology Company. This opportunity will give you experience in the technology sector in the United States with a company that is a globally recognized leader in smartphones, televisions, home appliances, and semiconductor innovation — and one of the most well\-known brands in the world.  

  

**LOCATION**Santa Ana, CA  

  

**COMPENSATION**$31\.70/hour  

  

**SCHEDULE**Fully on\-site, Monday\-Friday, 8am\-5pm.
Occasional extended hours may be required during peak export cycles or pricing update periods.  

  

**CONTRACT TERM**1\-year contract with a very high likelihood of extension/conversion to full\-time.  

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW**The Business Analyst I serves as a key operational and analytical support role within the organization, focusing on two primary functional areas: Export Order Management and Parts Pricing Management. This position plays a critical secondary support role requiring a high degree of organization, attention to detail, and strong interpersonal communication skills. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem\-solver who can manage multiple priorities, build cross\-functional relationships, and deliver accurate, timely reporting that supports business decisions.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**Export Specialist – Order Processing \& KPI Analysis:
* Process and manage export sales orders from initiation through final delivery, ensuring accuracy and compliance with export regulations and internal procedures.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for international subsidiary customers, maintaining professional and timely email communication to address inquiries, order status updates, and issue resolution.
* Coordinate logistics activities between freight forwarders, customers, and warehouse teams to ensure smooth order fulfillment and on\-time shipments.
* Monitor and track shipment milestones; proactively communicate delays or discrepancies to relevant stakeholders.
* Compile, analyze, and report on export Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including order fulfillment rates, lead times, shipping accuracy, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Maintain and organize export documentation, including shipping instructions, commercial invoices, packing lists, and any required compliance documents.
* Identify process gaps or recurring issues within the export workflow and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency.
* Support month\-end reporting related to export order volume, revenue, and performance trends.

Parts Pricing Management – CE \& MX Parts Support:
* Provide analytical and administrative support for pricing adjustments and updates for CE (Construction Equipment) and MX (Mexico) parts catalogs.
* Assist in reviewing, validating, and updating parts pricing data in applicable systems, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
* Coordinate with internal pricing, sales, and product teams to gather inputs needed for timely pricing updates.
* Support the preparation and distribution of pricing change communications to relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain organized records of pricing history, adjustment logs, and approval documentation.
* Assist in reconciling pricing discrepancies and escalating exceptions as needed.
Contribute to pricing performance reporting and analysis as directed.  
* 

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES*** Organization: Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; professional email correspondence with international customers is essential.
* Follow\-Up: Strong sense of accountability; proactively follows up on open items to drive resolution.
* Documentation: Meticulous in maintaining accurate, complete, and well\-organized records.
* Data Analysis: Ability to gather, interpret, and present data in meaningful reports and dashboards.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with cross\-functional teams, including warehouse, logistics, sales, and finance.
Attention to Detail: High accuracy in data entry, order processing, and pricing updates.  
* 

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**Education:
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance, International Business, or a related field preferred.

Experience:
* 1\-2 years of experience in a business operations, logistics, supply chain, customer service, or related analytical role.
* Prior experience in export operations, international customer support, or parts/pricing administration is a plus.

Technical Skills:
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data formatting).
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) preferred.
* Familiarity with order management or freight management platforms is a plus.
* Ability to create basic dashboards or reports in Excel or similar tools.

Language:
* English proficiency required (written communication skills are critical for international customer correspondence).
Bilingual (English/Korean) is a plus, given subsidiary interactions.  
* 

  

**PERFORMANCE METRICS*** Accuracy and timeliness of export order processing.
* Quality and responsiveness of customer and internal communications.
* On\-time coordination with freight forwarders and warehouse.
* KPI reporting completeness and delivery schedule adherence.
* Accuracy of parts pricing updates and documentation.

jobs.title: Budget Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20179545 **Category** Accounting, Finance and Banking
  
The Department of Population and Public Health Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine of USC is seeking a Budget/Business Analyst to support the department's financial and administrative operations.


Employment involves **(1\)** administering, monitoring, reconciling, and forecasting departmental budgets; **(2\)** preparing financial reports, researching variances, and supporting purchasing and other financial transactions; **(3\)** coordinating position\-control documentation and serving as a liaison with Keck School of Medicine Human Resources (KSOM HR) throughout hiring and position\-extension processes; and **(4\)** assisting faculty and managers/supervisors with service agreements, supplier onboarding, and personnel allocation entries in Workday.


The Budget/Business Analyst will work closely with faculty, managers, supervisors, department leadership, KSOM HR, vendors, and other university offices. The position will help employees navigate university policies and processes, review documents for completeness and accuracy, track submissions through completion, troubleshoot issues, and maintain organized records. The analyst will also prepare ad hoc analyses and contribute to process improvements that strengthen the department's business, finance, and administrative operations.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, service\-minded, and able to manage multiple priorities independently in a deadline\-driven environment. Strong judgment, problem\-solving, follow\-through, written and verbal communication, and discretion with sensitive financial and personnel information are essential.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Administer assigned budgets; monitor income and expenditures; prepare projections; analyze trends and variances; and recommend or prepare budget adjustments in accordance with university guidelines.
* Reconcile account balances and activity to university financial records; initiate correcting entries; prepare accurate financial reports; and coordinate month\-end and year\-end activity.
* Support faculty and staff with purchasing, travel and expense activity, vendor transactions, and interpretation of university financial policies and procedures.
* Assist in coordination of the department's position\-control process, including assisting faculty and managers/supervisors with required forms and supporting documentation for new hires, position extensions, resource employees, and postdoctoral employees.
* Review position\-control submissions for completeness, accuracy, appropriate approvals, funding, and consistency; track status and follow up on outstanding items; and interface with KSOM HR to facilitate timely submission and resolution.
* Assist faculty and managers/supervisors with independent contractor agreements and professional services agreements, including coordination of required documentation and routing.
* Support supplier/vendor onboarding and serve as a liaison among requestors, suppliers, KSOM HR, and other university offices as needed.
* Enter and maintain personnel allocations in Workday, confirm funding details, and help resolve allocation\-related discrepancies.
* Prepare ad hoc financial and operational reports and contribute to process documentation and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* At least one year of relevant budgeting, accounting, financial administration, or business operations experience.
* Demonstrated budgeting experience and knowledge of accounting principles and practices.
* Experience using Workday for financial, personnel, or related administrative transactions.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to organize, analyze, reconcile, and present financial data.
* Demonstrated accuracy, confidentiality, customer service, communication, and ability to manage multiple deadlines with limited supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in business administration, accounting, finance, or a related field, or combined experience and education as a substitute for the minimum education requirement.
* Two or more years of related experience in a university, academic medical center, or similarly complex organization.
* University budget experience and knowledge of university financial and human resources systems.
* Experience supporting hiring or position\-control processes, service agreements, supplier onboarding, and personnel allocation entry.
* Experience working directly with faculty, managers, supervisors, human resources partners, and vendors.

The hourly rate range for this position is $37\.88 \- $41\.56\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  

  

Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree Addtional Education Requirements Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education Minimum Experience: 1 year Minimum Skills: Business administration, accounting or related degree and budget experience including knowledge of government and fund accounting. Strong computer skills with use of automated spreadsheets. Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree Preferred Experience: 2 years Preferred Skills: University budget experience and knowledge of university financial systems.
**Job ID** REQ20179545 **Posted Date** 09/04/2026

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst, Paris
jobs.description:
**About Mirakl:**



Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.  

  

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI\-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).  

  

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450\+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third\-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.



For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.


**Mirakl in Numbers:**


* ️ Founded in 2012 \| Member of French Tech Next40
* 750\+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo


**Our Values:**



Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.



Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:


* **Work Hard Together:** Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
* **Get Things Done:** We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
* **Go Above \& Beyond:** We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
* **Succeed Through Expertise:** Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
* **Satisfy \& Empower Clients:** We're committed to our clients' success
**The Team You'll Join**
------------------------



You'll be part of our Revenue Operations team led by Julien Amoureaux, Team Lead, Revenue Operations. The team consists of 10 Revenue Operations Analysts working across all of Mirakl's suite of products. Together, you'll be driving the efficiency and scalability of Mirakl's sales cycle by ensuring systems, processes, and automation run seamlessly across the organization.

  


**Your Impact**
---------------


**Revenue Systems Support**


* Maintain and improve the tools supporting prospecting, sales execution, quoting, and revenue recognition across all of Mirakl's business units
* Administer Salesforce — managing users, permissions, workflows, approvals, and data quality — to keep the sales organization running smoothly
* Collaborate with RevOps Business Analysts to understand business needs and translate them into system or process improvements
* Partner with the RevOps Tech Lead on system architecture, integrations, data quality, and prioritization
* Document solutions, recurring issues, and standard operating procedures to build a reliable, scalable knowledge base for the team

  


**AI \& Automation**


* Design, deploy, and maintain AI\-agent processes and n8n workflows that automate recurring operational tasks across Revenue Operations
* Support business users and RevOps analysts in identifying automation opportunities and translating requirements into reliable, scalable solutions
* Monitor automated processes, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve their performance and usability
* Contribute to building a robust automation framework with appropriate documentation, controls, and support processes

  


**CPQ Transformation**


* Support the rollout of Mirakl's new AI\-enabled CPQ operating model, coordinating requirements, testing, documentation, and rollout activities
* Work cross\-functionally with Sales, Finance, RevOps, and technical stakeholders to ensure new CPQ processes meet business needs
* Monitor the reliability and performance of CPQ processes post\-launch and drive continuous improvement
* Contribute to migrating from manual administrative maintenance toward more automated management of product, pricing, and approval rules

  


**What You'll Bring to the Role**
---------------------------------


**Experience:**


* 2\+ years of experience supporting business applications such as **Salesforce**, CPQ, CRM, sales engagement tools, or related Revenue Operations platforms
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross\-functional projects with multiple stakeholders
* Hands\-on experience with or strong interest in AI agents, workflow automation, or tools such as n8n
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent experience

  


**Skills:**


* Analytical problem\-solving with strong attention to detail
* Ability to translate business requirements into system or automation solutions
* Clear communication and cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple requests
* Adaptability and eagerness to learn in a fast\-moving environment

 **Tools Used**
--------------


* **CRM:** Salesforce
* **CPQ:** DealHub or equivalent CPQ platform
* **Automation:** n8n, Dust, AI agents
* **Data Managerment :** Databricks
* **Sales Engagement:** Prospecting and outbounding tools (e.g. Gong, Outreach)
* **Productivity \& Documentation:** Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, Confluence or Notion

**Languages**
-------------


* English: C2 (Full professional proficiency)
* French: C2 (Full professional proficiency)

**Our Hiring Process**
----------------------



We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.



Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.


* **Intro call with Talent Acquisition** — 30 minutes to explore your background, motivations, and answer any questions about Mirakl
* **Interview with Julien, the hiring manager** — A deep dive into your RevOps experience, technical background, and motivations
* **Values\-based interviews**

jobs.title: Project Manager - Housing Element Services
jobs.description:
BKF is a multi\-service infrastructure consulting firm providing civil engineering, construction management, environmental, planning, and surveying services across California, the Pacific Northwest, and beyond. With offices throughout California and the Portland area, BKF has served transportation, water resources, land development, government, and federal clients for over 110 years.


At BKF, you’ll find a unique opportunity to grow your career with intention. Our culture values professional autonomy, innovation, and meaningful collaboration across offices. We are proud to be recognized with the Great Place to Work certification for the second year in a row.


The Project Manager – Housing Element Services leads project delivery and business development for Housing Element work within the Community Planning practice. This role reports to the Community Planning Practice Lead and is responsible for driving the firm’s growth in 7th cycle Housing Element updates and implementation, building on a track record of 6th cycle delivery. The Project Manager should have hands\-on experience managing Housing Element updates from background analysis through HCD certification, along with a working knowledge of RHNA methodology, site inventory requirements, rezoning programs, and affirmatively furthering fair housing (AFFH) analysis.


This is a seller\-doer role. The Project Manager will manage a portfolio of Housing Element projects while also leading the identification, pursuit, and capture of new 7th cycle opportunities, working closely with the Practice Lead on pipeline strategy and proposal development.

**Responsibilities**

**Project Management \& Delivery:**

* Serve as Project Manager on Housing Element update and implementation projects, including background reports, site inventories, program development, rezoning, and public engagement through HCD certification.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and subconsultant coordination to ensure quality delivery and client satisfaction.
* Guide clients through HCD review cycles and evolving state housing law requirements.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary internal teams across planning, environmental, and engineering disciplines.

**Business Development \& Pursuit Leadership:**

* Lead the firm’s strategy for identifying and pursuing 7th cycle Housing Element opportunities, with a focus on the Bay Area and LA metro markets.
* Track upcoming Housing Element RFP releases and position the firm ahead of key pursuits.
* Lead proposal development and RFP responses, partnering with the Practice Lead and Business Development team on go\-to\-market strategy.
* Build and maintain relationships with city and county planning staff, HCD, and housing stakeholders.
* Contribute to the achievement of overall Planning sector sales and booking goals.

**Community Engagement:**

* Lead public outreach and engagement efforts for Housing Element updates, including community workshops, stakeholder meetings, and public hearings.
* Develop accessible outreach materials that clearly communicate housing policy and program concepts to diverse communities.
* Apply an equity lens to engagement strategy, consistent with AFFH requirements.

**Client Engagement:**

* Serve as a key point of contact for project clients, maintaining strong relationships and proactively addressing client needs.
* Represent the firm at local industry events, conferences, and public agency meetings.

**Collaboration \& Team Development:**

* Work collaboratively with the broader Community Planning team and other service lines, including Resiliency, Environmental Compliance, and Housing.
* Support mentorship and professional development of junior staff, with a path toward supervising direct reports as the Housing Element portfolio grows.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  

**Requirements**  

* Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in community planning, with a focus on Housing Element preparation and implementation.
* Demonstrated experience serving as Project Manager or a lead team member on at least one 6th cycle (2021–2029\) Housing Element update.
* Working knowledge of RHNA methodology, site inventory requirements, rezoning programs, and AFFH analysis.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to business development, including proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations; prior seller\-doer experience preferred.
* Strong community engagement skills, with experience facilitating public meetings and developing outreach materials.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex housing policy topics clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Remote/hybrid position; candidates established in the Bay Area or LA metro area are preferred.
* Willingness to travel as needed to support project sites, client meetings, and regional offices.
* Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning, Public Policy, or a closely related field is required.
* AICP certification is preferred.


Physical Demands: Must be able to regularly talk, hear and operate a computer, keyboard and mouse and occasionally lift, pull/push and carry up to 20 pounds with accommodations.


Work Conditions: Exposure to constant or intermittent sounds at a low or moderate level consistent with an office setting. Exposure to high\-stress, fast\-paced, deadline\-oriented environment. Travel to other BKF locations and client sites may be required.

 **Benefits**  

* The typical base salary range for this position is $139,744\.8 \- $170,799\.2 annualized depending upon skills, experience, education, and geographical location. This is a salary position paid biweekly.
* Competitive salaries, profit sharing, and 401k.
* Generous paid time off packages.
* 9 Paid Holidays.
* Flexible schedules.
* Education reimbursement, paid annual dues for professional

jobs.title: Program Manager - Environmental Education & Community Engagement
jobs.description:
**Program Manager – Environmental Education \& Community Engagement**

**Painted Bins \& Resilient Neighborhoods \| Projects of Sustainable Marin**  
**Location:** Marin County, CA \| Hybrid  
**Salary:** $65,000 annually, plus benefits included below  
**Schedule:** Full\-time; occasional evening and weekend events

*Help Build a More Sustainable Marin*

Are you passionate about creating a more sustainable future? Painted Bins and Resilient Neighborhoods, projects of nonprofit Sustainable Marin, are seeking a collaborative, organized, and mission\-driven **Program Manager** to help educate, engage, and inspire Marin County residents to take meaningful climate action.

The **Program Manager** position offers the opportunity to work with both youth and adults, lead impactful environmental education and community engagement programs, and make a visible difference while working with a small, supportive team committed to innovation, collaboration, and lasting community impact.

**About Us**

**Painted Bins** empowers youth to become environmental stewards through environmental education, visual arts, and public speaking. Students turn what they learn into action, using their voices and creativity to inspire community\-wide behavior change. *www.paintedbins.org*

**Resilient Neighborhoods** empowers Marin County residents to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, prepare for climate\-related emergencies, and build stronger, more resilient communities through education and local action. *www.resilientneighborhoods.org*

Both organizations are projects of **Sustainable Marin**, a Marin County nonprofit organization. *www.SustainableMarin.org*

**The Opportunity**

As Program Manager, you will work closely with the leadership of Painted Bins and Resilient Neighborhoods to keep programs and projects organized, moving forward, and aligned with strategic priorities.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys managing multiple projects, working with a wide range of people, improving systems, and turning ideas into action. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to two growing environmental programs and see the direct impact of your work throughout Marin County.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Manage multiple programs and projects from planning through implementation.

· Coordinate educational programs, community outreach, art shows, volunteer activities, and fundraising events.

· Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, workflows, and organizational systems using Monday.com and related platforms.

· Recruit, coordinate, and support volunteers.

· Build and maintain relationships with schools, community organizations, businesses, volunteers, and other partners.

· Track program outcomes, maintain databases, and analyze information to help measure impact.

· Identify opportunities to improve organizational systems and administrative processes.

· Support strategic initiatives that strengthen and expand environmental education and climate action programs.

· Balance priorities across two collaborative organizations while maintaining strong communication and attention to detail.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

· Bachelor’s degree.

· 2–5 years of experience in program management, project management, nonprofit administration, education, community engagement, or a related field.

· Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Experience with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and online software platforms or databases.

· Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for local meetings and events.

**Especially Helpful**

· Experience or interest in sustainability, climate action, environmental education, or community\-based programs.

· Experience working with schools, volunteers, community organizations, or nonprofit programs.

· Familiarity with Monday.com or similar project\-management platforms.

· A collaborative, flexible approach and enthusiasm for working in a small, mission\-driven organization.

· Spanish bilingual

**Position Requirements**

This is a hybrid position combining remote work with in\-person meetings, school and community activities, and events throughout Marin County. Occasional evening and weekend work and lifting of up to 30 pounds are required.

**Compensation**

**$65,000 annually, plus benefits to include paid time off and access to California retirement savings plan**

**How to Apply**

Please submit a **resume and cover letter to info.PaintedBins@gmail.com** describing your interest in the position and your experience in climate action and managing programs, projects, and/or community initiatives.

We are looking for someone who is excited to bring strong organizational skills, initiative, and a collaborative spirit to work that helps create a more sustainable and resilient Marin County.

Pay: $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Marin County, CA

jobs.title: Senior Operations Data Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Senior Operations Data Analyst**


**About the Company**



The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring \>10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy\-to\-find, near\-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under\-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.



KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold\-owned\-and\-operated exploration programs. Since founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.



KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 80 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high\-quality discovery.



KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

  


**About the Role**



Senior individual contributor reporting to the Head of Operations Data, coordinating day to day with the broader team and functional stakeholders. Owns systems end to end — data model, ETL, application, and stakeholder relationships — with minimal oversight from day one, and mentors junior analysts. Approximate initial allocation:


**Responsibilities**


* **45% Build \& integration** — new data models, ETL/API integrations, and app support (Foundry et al.)
* **25% Platform maintenance \& data quality** — OPSDB stewardship, sync reliability, alerting, production support
* **15% Governance \& technical debt** — RBAC, scoped roles, dbt semantic layer, documentation
* **15% Mingomba support \& cross\-functional mentorship** — commitments register, peer mentorship and skill growth, coordination with Mingomba functional growth like Procurement, Inventory


**Qualifications**


* 5\+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data operations owning production systems independently
* Strong SQL and data modeling (PostgreSQL)
* Proven ETL and API integration
* Experience and comfort with AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.)
* Dbt, cloud tooling (AWS/S3\), finance\-systems (NetSuite/Tipalti), or geospatial data a plus.
* Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.
* Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who are not technical. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.
* Excitement about joining a fast\-growing early\-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities.
* Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.
* A valid passport and willingness to travel to observe our work at Mingomba or at an exploration site around the world. Light travel is required when necessary.

  



KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.



This position is Full\-time Exempt



The US base salary range for this full\-time exempt position is $100,000 to $125,000 plus equity and benefits including 401k matching.



Location: KoBold is a remote\-first workplace. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in one of the following countries: United States or Canada.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer\-facing work actually succeed.


Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous Great Place to Work accolades, including **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **\#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.


We’re looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager / Senior Implementation Manager to join our Success Services team in the US. You will lead Front’s most complex customer implementations across net\-new onboarding, enterprise expansion, workflow transformation, migration, and adoption of new capabilities.


You will be the customer’s primary implementation partner and a senior advisor throughout the engagement. You’ll uncover business goals, translate complex processes into scalable Front workflows, establish the project operating model, lead change and enablement, navigate technical dependencies, and drive teams toward measurable value.


This is a hands\-on role for an experienced implementation leader. You will independently manage high\-stakes engagements while also improving how our team works through stronger playbooks, reusable solutions, coaching, and cross\-functional partnership.

**What will you be doing?**

* Own complex, multi\-workstream implementation engagements from discovery and solution design through launch, adoption, and value realization.
* Advise customer leaders on future\-state workflows, operating models, governance, and change—not simply configure stated requirements.
* Build and drive clear project plans, decision frameworks, stakeholder cadences, risk registers, and executive updates across multiple concurrent engagements.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
At **Benchmark** , we are driven by our purpose: to innovate for a healthier, safer, and better\-connected world to create a brighter future. When you join us, you become part of a team passionate about making a meaningful impact across various sectors, including commercial aerospace, defense, advanced computing, next\-generation communications, complex industrials, medical, and semiconductor capital equipment. We prioritize career growth, fostering a culture that ensures you reach your full potential. At Benchmark, your work is purpose\-driven, enabling you to create a positive impact on the world and make your career truly meaningful. You’ll be part of a collaborative and inclusive team that values your ideas and contributions.  

  



**Summary:**  

The program manager is responsible for the execution of customer strategies related to one or more customers including all products/programs from new product introduction through volume production. He/she is responsible for achieving high customer satisfaction, driving profitable business relationships and sales growth and providing strong leadership to the customer focus teams to ensure achievement of customer commitments.


**Responsibilities:**

* Acts as primary day\-to\-day customer point of contact and functions as the primary Customer contact in resolution management and responsible for the overall health of the customer relationship.
